intent: An agent asks for standing access to a capability (files, email, repo, billing), scope by scope, with why and expiry. Grant / Deny, then one line.
useWhen: an agent needs access that lasts beyond one action
several scopes with read / write / admin levels
the grant can fail and needs Retry
doNotUseWhen: a settings toggle the person flips themselves — Switch
a must-choose interruption for the whole page — AlertDialog

scopes.note: { id, resource, access: "read" | "write" | "admin", reason?, expiry?, icon? }[]

status.note: granted / denied / expired render one line.

onGrant.note: Grant, the one solid primary. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter inside the card.

onDeny.note: Deny, outline. Escape inside the card.

onRetry.note: Error row Retry. Falls back to onGrant.

requirements: scopes are a list; access is text in a Badge
Escape denies, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter grants while focus is in the card; buttons carry aria-keyshortcuts
granting sets aria-busy and announces in a status region
the error is role=alert with a Retry button
motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local PermissionCard, AccessRequest, or ScopePicker
Do not hide expiry or the standing-access warning for write or admin
Grant is the one solid primary; Deny is outline
snippet: <PermissionRequest description="Research agent wants standing access." scopes={[{ id: "docs", resource: "~/acme/ledger/docs", access: "read", reason: "Summarise weekly doc changes.", expiry: "Expires in 7 days" }]} onGrant={grant} onDeny={deny} />
